name: Asian Woman

source.title: Original low-poly avatar mesh generated for Vox
source.creator: Vox project

notes: The GLB is bundled at addons/asian-woman/asian_woman.glb and app/src/main/assets/avatars/asian_woman.glb.
The original stylized low-poly full-body avatar is registered as the built-in Asian Woman roster entry.
The parser reads static mesh geometry but does not currently render COLOR_0 vertex colors.
The current parser does not implement JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 skinning or animation playback.
No facial morph targets are included; audio-driven viseme lip-sync is not supported.
